# Misfit Mediahouse — Machine Products + Agent Infrastructure

Misfit Mediahouse builds hosted tools, machine-commerce surfaces, agent security, and infrastructure that can be consumed directly by AI systems.

## Durable agent control plane
Human-readable control plane: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agents
A2A Agent Card: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
Canonical agent-facing business map: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agents.md
Static public-safe stack manifest: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-stack.json
Live public-safe health API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-agent-hub/health
Public-safe recovery guide: https://github.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/Misfit-media-designer-lite/blob/main/docs/AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY.md
Canonical runtime state lives in Misfit Cloud/Supabase; source and recovery metadata live in GitHub; the website is the durable public control surface. Chat sessions are operators, not databases.
Private GHOSBC/Castle Gate runtime details are intentionally not exposed through these public surfaces.

## A2A — Misfit Machine Agent
A2A v1.0 JSONRPC endpoint: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-a2a/rpc
A2A v1.0 HTTP+JSON endpoint: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-a2a
Agent Card: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
Third-party A2A registry identity: a2aregistry.org/agents/9bfce891-edc3-4ba9-ba84-53f8873007c6
Current skill: `audit_shopify_agentic_storefront`.
The JSONRPC and HTTP+JSON bindings are both smoke-proven for equivalent direct Message behavior. The third-party registry's A2A SDK verified the JSONRPC binding at registration and marked its synchronous probe WORKING. The agent accepts a public Shopify store domain/HTTPS URL in text or structured-data Message parts and returns a direct `ROLE_AGENT` Message with text plus structured audit data. Streaming and push notifications are not advertised. No cart, checkout, order, payment, credential or store mutation capability is exposed.

## Machine commerce discovery
UCP business profile: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/ucp
UCP REST catalog: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-ucp
UCP MCP storefront: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-store-mcp
MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/misfit-machine-store
Catalog search and lookup are advertised. UCP REST catalog responses use a public verification key from the business profile and HTTP message-signature headers. Purchase handoff uses each product's existing Stripe checkout flow; UCP checkout is not advertised.
The free Shopify Agentic Storefront Audit is a real $0 UCP catalog item with no checkout URL; it points to the public diagnostic, its callable Safety Gate MCP tool, and the live A2A audit skill.

## Shopify Agentic Audit
Public-metadata-only UCP/MCP storefront readiness and tool-surface audit for Shopify stores. It inspects public `/.well-known/ucp`, `/agents.md`, and storefront MCP metadata, and never executes cart, checkout, order, payment, credential, or mutation actions.
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/shopify-ai-audit
API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/shopify-agentic-audit
MCP: call `audit_shopify_agentic_storefront` on GHOSBC Safety Gate MCP.
A2A: call `audit_shopify_agentic_storefront` through either declared Misfit Machine Agent binding.
Audited stores can receive a live embeddable diagnostic badge that links back to their independently rerunnable report. Grades are Misfit diagnostics, not Shopify certification.
The audit funnels consequential tool surfaces through GHOSBC Safety Gate and recommends ChangePacket for future surface drift.

## ChangePacket
Persistent change memory for AI agents. Track public webpages or public MCP tool surfaces. First request creates a baseline; later requests return only the delta.
Product: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/deltafeed
MCP: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/changepacket-mcp
OpenAPI: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/deltafeed/openapi.json
MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/changepacket
Pricing: 25 free calls/day; 2,000 prepaid calls for $9.

## GHOSBC Safety Gate
Hosted AI-agent governance boundary. Screen requests, MCP dependencies/tool definitions, Shopify agentic storefront metadata, bounded consequential actions, outbound payloads, and responses. Public interfaces expose decisions, public-safe summaries, sanitization, and audit digests only; private GHOSBC runtime internals are not published.
Product: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-safety-gate
MCP: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-safety-gate-mcp
MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/ghosbc-safety-gate
Pricing: 50 free checks/day; 10,000 prepaid checks for $19.

## ContextForge
Metadata-aware code generation and change governance grounded in DataHub context. ContextForge reasons about blast radius, governance, generated code/tests, approval boundaries, and decision memory. This is a first-class Misfit machine asset, not a chat-only prototype.
App: https://contextforge-datahub-app.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/contextforge-datahub
ContextForge is currently a DataHub-aware application/client; do not assume a standalone remote ContextForge MCP or A2A server unless one is explicitly published.

## Private security core
GHOSBC OS – Agent Brain Hub and Misfit Shield – GHOSBC Sentinel provide private governance, Castle Gate evaluation, approval gates, abuse controls, runtime validation, outbound-context shielding, and sentinel orchestration. Their private source, prompts, cipher/mapping internals, runtime material, and credentials are not public machine interfaces.
